```{r setup}
# The conference abstract on the walking question against PASE (the pase_walking step). The
# wording lives in the `text` chunk below; every number comes from the run.
source("report_setup.R")
source("brief_figures.R")  # star helpers (fig_stars, fig_with_stars, fig_star_key)
source("pase_figures.R")
limit <- 5000      # the submission's characters: title, body and spaces
per_image <- 560   # an image is charged up to this many

one <- function(x, what) {
  if (length(x) != 1 || is.na(x)) stop("abstract_pase.qmd: no single value for ", what, call. = FALSE)
  x
}
metric <- function(key) one(run$metrics[[key]], key)
# A contrast against non-walkers (who answered no); numbers by means (as the figures show them),
# yes/no outcomes (any walking, each band of weekly hours) by shares
contrast <- function(grouping, visit, outcome, level, col,
                     estimator = if (outcome == "walking_any" || startsWith(outcome, "band ")) "share" else "mean") {
  k <- pw_contrasts[pw_contrasts$grouping == grouping & pw_contrasts$visit == visit &
                      pw_contrasts$outcome == outcome & pw_contrasts$level == level &
                      pw_contrasts$estimator == estimator, col]
  one(k, paste(grouping, visit, outcome, level, estimator, col))
}
group_value <- function(grouping, visit, outcome, level, col = "estimate") {
  g <- pw_groups[pw_groups$grouping == grouping & pw_groups$visit == visit &
                   pw_groups$outcome == outcome & pw_groups$level == level, col]
  one(g, paste(grouping, visit, outcome, level, col))
}
# "20 [95% CI 10 to 30]": square brackets, as the estimates sit inside parentheses; later
# intervals drop "95% CI"
ci <- function(est, lo, hi, digits, label = FALSE) {
  sprintf("%s [%s%s to %s]", num(est, digits), if (label) "95% CI " else "", num(lo, digits), num(hi, digits))
}
adj <- function(grouping, visit, outcome, level, digits = 1, label = FALSE) {
  ci(contrast(grouping, visit, outcome, level, "adj_estimate"), contrast(grouping, visit, outcome, level, "adj_lo"),
     contrast(grouping, visit, outcome, level, "adj_hi"), digits, label)
}
and2 <- function(x) if (length(x) == 1) x[[1]] else paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[length(x)])
asked <- "10"  # the visit of the walking question (96 months)
visits <- unlist(assumption("pase.all_visits"))
month_of <- function(v) one(unique(pw_groups$month[pw_groups$visit == v]), paste("month of", v))
total_visits <- sort(unique(pw_groups$visit[pw_groups$outcome == "total"]))
last_total <- total_visits[length(total_visits)]
labels <- lapply(assumption("components.answer_labels"), unlist)
# Follow-up span, from the last PASE visit (192 months = 16 years)
span_years <- num(max(pw_groups$month) / 12, 0)
```

```{r text}
n_all <- metric("pase.persons"); n_yes <- metric("pase.yes")
times_levels <- c("1", "2", "3"); years_levels <- c("1", "2", "3", "4")
or_any <- function(v) adj("any", v, "walking_any", "yes", digits = 1)
mean_diff <- function(v, label = FALSE) adj("any", v, "total", "yes", digits = 0, label = label)
# Is every visit's adjusted contrast (means for the total, shares for any walking) significant?
every_visit <- function(outcome, estimator) {
  p <- pw_contrasts$adj_p_holm[pw_contrasts$grouping == "any" & pw_contrasts$outcome == outcome &
                                 pw_contrasts$estimator == estimator]
  length(p) > 0 && all(!is.na(p) & p < 0.05)
}
both_every <- every_visit("total", "mean") && every_visit("walking_any", "share")
trend_p <- function(grouping, outcome = "walking_any") {
  p <- run$pase_walking_trend
  p <- p[p$grouping == grouping & pw_visit(p$visit) == asked & p$outcome == outcome, "p"]
  p <- one(p, paste("trend", grouping))
  if (p < 0.001) "p<0.001" else sprintf("p=%s", num(p, 3))
}
# Share of a group walking at least 5 hours a week (the top two bands)
long_walk <- function(level, visit = asked) {
  b <- pw_bands[pw_bands$grouping == "any" & pw_bands$visit == visit & pw_bands$level == level, ]
  one(sum(b$share[b$band %in% c("5–10", "10+")]), paste("5+ hours", level))
}
n_with <- function(visit) {
  sum(pw_groups$n[pw_groups$grouping == "any" & pw_groups$visit == visit & pw_groups$outcome == "total"])
}
last_walk <- visits[length(visits)]

title <- sprintf("SINGLE REPORT OF RETROSPECTIVE WALKING BEHAVIOR CONFIRMED USING A REPEATED SHORT-TERM WALKING QUESTIONNAIRE OVER %s YEARS", span_years)

purpose <- "In the Osteoarthritis Initiative, a single question asked at the 96-month visit about walking for exercise since age 50 has been linked to fewer people developing frequent knee pain. We assessed its construct validity against the Physical Activity Scale for the Elderly (PASE), a 7-day activity questionnaire repeated before, at and after the visit at which the question was asked."

# How the p-values were adjusted, from the ledger: "p-values Holm-adjusted across visits"
p_method <- assumption("pase_walking.p_adjust")
p_note <- if (p_method == "none") "unadjusted p-values" else sprintf(
  "p-values %s-adjusted %s", tools::toTitleCase(p_method),
  if (assumption("pase_walking.p_adjust_family") == "across_visits") "across visits" else "within each visit")
methods <- paste0(
  "Participants reported whether they had walked for exercise (at least 20 minutes a day, at least 10 times) since age 50 and, if so, how many times a month and for how many years. ",
  sprintf("PASE was collected at %s months (the walking item also at %s months). ",
          and2(vapply(total_visits, month_of, numeric(1))), num(month_of(last_walk), 0)),
  "At each visit, walkers (who answered yes) were compared with non-walkers (no) on the mean PASE total score (linear regression), any walking outside the home (PASE item 2; logistic regression) and each band of estimated weekly walking hours (item 2 days × hours a day; logistic regression), adjusted for age, sex and body-mass index, with ", p_note, "; walkers were also grouped by frequency and years walked, with tests for trend.")

results <- paste(
  sprintf("Of %s participants, %s (%s) reported walking for exercise since age 50; %s had a PASE total at enrollment and %s at %s months.",
          count(n_all), count(n_yes), pct(n_yes / n_all), count(n_with("00")), count(n_with(last_total)), num(month_of(last_total), 0)),
  sprintf("At 96 months, walkers had a higher mean PASE total (%s vs %s; adjusted difference %s), more often reported any walking (%s vs %s; adjusted odds ratio %s) and more often walked 5 or more hours a week (%s vs %s).",
          num(group_value("any", asked, "total", "yes", "mean"), 0), num(group_value("any", asked, "total", "no", "mean"), 0),
          mean_diff(asked, label = TRUE),
          pct(group_value("any", asked, "walking_any", "yes")), pct(group_value("any", asked, "walking_any", "no")),
          or_any(asked), pct(long_walk("yes")), pct(long_walk("no"))),
  sprintf("Both differed at %s visit, from enrollment (difference %s; odds ratio %s) to %s months (%s; %s), and any walking also at %s months (%s; Figures 1 and 2).",
          if (both_every) "every" else "most", mean_diff("00"), or_any("00"),
          num(month_of(last_total), 0), mean_diff(last_total), or_any(last_total),
          num(month_of(last_walk), 0), or_any(last_walk)))
# Weekly walking-hours bands: at which visits walkers differ from non-walkers in each (adjusted,
# Holm across visits); every significant band must favor walkers, as the sentence says
hour_bands <- c("<2" = "under 2", "2–5" = "2–5", "5–10" = "5–10", "10+" = "10 or more")
band_months <- lapply(stats::setNames(names(hour_bands), names(hour_bands)), function(b) {
  k <- pw_contrasts[pw_contrasts$grouping == "any" & pw_contrasts$outcome == paste("band", b) &
                      pw_contrasts$level == "yes" & !is.na(pw_contrasts$adj_p_holm) & pw_contrasts$adj_p_holm < 0.05, ]
  if (any(k$adj_estimate <= 1)) stop("abstract_pase.qmd: non-walkers more often in band ", b, call. = FALSE)
  sort(vapply(k$visit, month_of, numeric(1)))
})
band_share <- function(b, level) {
  one(pw_bands$share[pw_bands$grouping == "any" & pw_bands$visit == asked & pw_bands$level == level &
                       pw_bands$band == b], paste("band", b, level))
}
every_band <- names(Filter(function(m) length(m) == length(visits), band_months))
some_band <- names(Filter(function(m) length(m) > 0 && length(m) < length(visits), band_months))
no_band <- names(Filter(function(m) length(m) == 0, band_months))
# A Holm-adjusted p as text; an odds ratio [95% CI] with its p, for a grouping, outcome and level
p_text <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) "p<0.001" else if (p > 0.99) "p>0.99" else sprintf("p=%s", num(p, if (p < 0.01) 3 else 2))
}
or_p <- function(grouping, visit, outcome, level) {
  sprintf("%s, %s", adj(grouping, visit, outcome, level, digits = 1), p_text(contrast(grouping, visit, outcome, level, "adj_p_holm")))
}
band_p <- function(b) {  # the largest Holm p of a band over the visits, rounded up
  p <- max(pw_contrasts$adj_p_holm[pw_contrasts$grouping == "any" & pw_contrasts$outcome == paste("band", b) &
                                     pw_contrasts$level == "yes"])
  if (p < 0.001) "p<0.001" else sprintf("p≤%s", num(round_up(p, 1), if (p < 0.01) 3 else 2))
}
visit_of <- function(m) one(unique(pw_groups$visit[pw_groups$month == m]), paste("visit of month", m))
band_parts <- c(
  if (length(every_band)) sprintf("%s hours a week at every visit%s", and2(hour_bands[every_band]),
                                  if (length(every_band) == 1) sprintf(" (at 96 months %s vs %s; adjusted odds ratio %s; %s at every visit)",
                                    pct(band_share(every_band, "yes")), pct(band_share(every_band, "no")),
                                    or_p("any", asked, paste("band", every_band), "yes"), band_p(every_band)) else ""),
  vapply(some_band, function(b) {
    sprintf("%s hours at %s months (%s)", hour_bands[[b]], and2(num(band_months[[b]], 0)),
            paste(vapply(band_months[[b]], function(m) or_p("any", visit_of(m), paste("band", b), "yes"), ""), collapse = "; "))
  }, ""))
bands_sentence <- paste0(
  if (length(band_parts)) sprintf("By weekly walking hours, walkers more often walked %s", and2(band_parts)) else "Walkers and non-walkers did not differ in any band of weekly walking hours",
  if (length(no_band) && length(band_parts)) {
    sprintf("; differences in %s hours a week were not significant after adjustment across visits (at 96 months %s)",
            and2(hour_bands[no_band]), paste(vapply(no_band, function(b) or_p("any", asked, paste("band", b), "yes"), ""), collapse = "; "))
  } else "",
  ".")
results <- paste(results, bands_sentence)
# The dose sentence: kept, and flagged in the review copies for the original authors' decision
amount_ors <- function(grouping, levels) and2(vapply(levels, function(lv) adj(grouping, asked, "walking_any", lv, digits = 1), ""))
dose <- sprintf("At 96 months, the adjusted odds of any walking against non-walkers rose with frequency (%s for %s times a month) and with years walked (%s for %s years; trend %s for both).",
                amount_ors("times", times_levels), and2(sub(" times/month$", "", labels$times)),
                amount_ors("years", years_levels), and2(tolower(sub(" years$", "", labels$years))),
                and2(unique(c(trend_p("times"), trend_p("years")))))
results <- paste(results, dose)

conclusions <- sprintf("A single retrospective report of walking for exercise since age 50 was confirmed by a repeated 7-day activity questionnaire over %s years: those who reported it were more active and more likely to walk at %s visit, before, at and after the question. This supports the question's construct validity as a measure of a long-term walking habit.", span_years, if (both_every) "every" else "most")

# Figures: saved for upload, captions keyed to the stars they show
fig1 <- fig_pase_total(); fig2 <- fig_pase_walking()
oaireport::save_figure(fig1, "abstract_pase_fig1", "2col", height = 3.0)
oaireport::save_figure(fig2, "abstract_pase_fig2", "2col", height = 3.0)
key <- function(fig, what) {
  k <- fig_star_key(attr(fig, "stars"))
  if (nzchar(k)) sprintf(" %s, %s, walkers vs non-walkers, adjusted for age, sex and body-mass index; %s.", k, what, p_note) else ""
}
figures <- c(
  abstract_pase_fig1 = paste0("PASE total score, mean (95% CI), at each visit for walkers and non-walkers (yes or no to walking for exercise since age 50, asked at 96 months, dashed line); n of each group below.",
                              key(fig1, "difference in means")),
  abstract_pase_fig2 = paste0("Share with any PASE walking (walking outside the home in the past 7 days), % (95% CI), at each visit for walkers and non-walkers (as in Figure 1); n of each group below.",
                              key(fig2, "odds of any walking")))
captions <- stats::setNames(unname(figures), sprintf("Figure %d caption", seq_along(figures)))

fields <- c(Title = title, Purpose = purpose, Methods = methods, Results = results,
            Conclusions = conclusions, captions)
budget <- oaireport::char_budget(fields, images = length(figures), per_image = per_image, limit = limit)

# The paste file: one block per field with its count, the images to upload, then the budget
dir.create("text", showWarnings = FALSE)
blocks <- unlist(lapply(names(fields), function(f) c(sprintf("%s (%s characters)", toupper(f), count(nchar(fields[[f]]))), fields[[f]], "")))
budget_lines <- paste(format(budget$part, width = 24), count(budget$characters))
uploads <- sprintf("Figure %d: figures/%s.png", seq_along(figures), names(figures))
paste_file <- file(file.path("text", "abstract_pase.txt"), open = "w", encoding = "UTF-8")
writeLines(c(blocks, "IMAGES TO UPLOAD", uploads, "", "CHARACTER BUDGET", budget_lines), paste_file)
close(paste_file)
```

```{r show}
#| results: asis
body <- c(Purpose = purpose, Methods = methods, Results = results, Conclusions = conclusions)
# In the review PDF only: the dose sentence highlighted, with a question for the original authors
flagged <- sprintf("`#highlight(fill: rgb(\"#fff2a8\"))[`{=typst}%s`]`{=typst} ***[For co-authors: keep this sentence on frequency and years walked?]***", dose)
# Escape * so Markdown prints a star key rather than reading it as emphasis, then add the flag
body <- vapply(body, function(x) gsub("*", "\\*", x, fixed = TRUE), character(1))
body[["Results"]] <- sub(dose, flagged, body[["Results"]], fixed = TRUE)
cat("## ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
for (f in names(body)) cat(sprintf("**%s.** %s\n\n", f, body[[f]]))
for (i in seq_along(figures)) {
  cat(oaireport::figure_group(), sep = "\n")
  cat(figure_file(names(figures)[i], width = "100%"), sep = "\n")
  cat(oaireport::table_note(figures[[i]], label = sprintf("Figure %d", i), close_group = TRUE), sep = "\n")
}
```
